title: Just Juice Bar Range Blackcurrant Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The Just Juice Bar Range Blackcurrant Lemonade Nic Salt e-liquid combines the rich, tart sweetness of juicy Blackcurrants with the effervescent zest of classic Lemonade. This vibrant blend recreates the bold, punchy taste of disposable vape flavours, making it a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy fruity e-liquids with a zesty, refreshing finish. With its 60PG/40VG formulation, the Just Juice Bar Range delivers exceptional flavour and a smooth yet satisfying throat hit. Perfect for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid offers rapid nicotine relief, making it a convenient and effective alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Blackcurrant Lemonade offers a bold, fruity vape experience for all-day enjoyment. Part of the Just Juice Bar Range, this collection brings the vibrant, extra-concentrated flavours enjoyed in disposable vapes to a more economical and versatile format suitable for reusable vape devices. Explore other delicious options like Lychee & Mango, Spearmint, and Sour Blue Razz Lime for more intense flavour adventures. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
